paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: The figure illustrates the BLEU score, a metric for evaluating the quality of machine translation, plotted against the average lagging (AL) value. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 0 to 8, with tick intervals of 1, and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 20 to 30, with tick intervals of 2, and uses a linear scale.  Five lines represent the BLEU scores for different experimental configurations: “Consistency-Bi + sampling” is represented by a solid orange line, “Consistency-Bi” is represented by a dashed green line, “Consistency-CE” is represented by a solid blue line, and “Consistency-Bi + beam” is represented by a dotted red line. The lines begin at approximately 24 and progress to around 29.5 for the "Consistency-CE" line, 23.5 for the “Consistency-Bi” line, 27 for the "Consistency-Bi + beam" line, and 25.5 for the “Consistency-Bi + sampling” line.  A gray shaded area indicates the range of 26 to 28 for the "Consistency-Bi" line.  A legend identifies each line with its corresponding label.
